# node-worker: plain syscall allowlist for a Node media parser on aarch64
# (musl, node:22-alpine). Everything here is granted UNCONDITIONALLY; the
# argument-filtered calls (socket→AF_UNIX, clone→no namespace flags, ioctl→a
# tiny request set, prctl→name/vma only) and the io_uring→ENOSYS shims are added
# by seccomp.rs and must NOT appear below (profile.rs rejects a reserved name).
#
# A0 STARTING POINT. §16.6 says the shipped profiles are generated by `strace -f`
# over the §4 corpus and reviewed; the A0 probe (deploy/enclave/probe) runs a
# jailed worker under this list and reports every syscall the kernel refused, so
# this set is widened to exactly what sharp + pdfjs-dist need before A1. It errs
# toward the syscalls a V8 + libuv + libvips worker is already known to make;
# anything missing shows up as a KILL in the probe, never as a silent bypass.
#
# aarch64 has no open/stat/poll/dup2/fork/pipe/mkdir/rename/unlink/access — only
# the *at and the newer forms — so only those appear here.

# --- stdio, files, directories ---
read
write
readv
writev
pread64
pwrite64
preadv2
pwritev2
close
close_range
lseek
openat
openat2
fstat
newfstatat
statx
fstatfs
statfs
getdents64
faccessat
faccessat2
readlinkat
mkdirat
unlinkat
renameat2
symlinkat
linkat
ftruncate
fallocate
fsync
fdatasync
fcntl
flock
dup
dup3
pipe2
getcwd

# --- memory ---
brk
mmap
mprotect
munmap
mremap
madvise
mlock
mlock2
munlock
memfd_create

# --- signals ---
rt_sigaction
rt_sigprocmask
rt_sigreturn
rt_sigtimedwait
rt_sigpending
rt_sigsuspend
sigaltstack
signalfd4
tgkill
kill
restart_syscall

# --- threads, scheduling, futexes ---
futex
futex_waitv
set_robust_list
get_robust_list
rseq
set_tid_address
sched_yield
sched_getaffinity
sched_getparam
sched_getscheduler
sched_get_priority_max
sched_get_priority_min
membarrier
gettid
getpid
getppid

# --- time ---
nanosleep
clock_nanosleep
clock_gettime
clock_getres
gettimeofday
timerfd_create
timerfd_settime
timerfd_gettime

# --- event loop ---
epoll_create1
epoll_ctl
epoll_pwait
epoll_pwait2
eventfd2
ppoll
pselect6

# --- identity, limits, misc info ---
getuid
geteuid
getgid
getegid
getgroups
getrandom
capget
uname
sysinfo
getrlimit
prlimit64
getrusage
getcpu

# --- already-open socket fds (creation is arg-filtered in code to AF_UNIX) ---
sendmsg
recvmsg
sendto
recvfrom
shutdown
getsockname
getpeername
getsockopt
setsockopt

# --- process teardown ---
wait4
waitid
exit
exit_group
